intro.part1: Hereinafter, EventNest respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you provide when using our website (
intro.part2: ). This document explains what data we collect, how we use it, your rights, and defines the payment refund conditions.

s1.title: 1. What Data We Collect
s1.desc: Depending on the service, we may collect the following information:
s1.item4: IP address, browser and device details

s2.title: 2. How We Collect Data
s2.item1: When you register on the website
s2.item2: When you fill out a contact or order form
s2.item3: When you subscribe to our newsletter
s2.item4: Automatically via cookies and analytics tools

s3.title: 3. Why We Use Your Data
s3.item4: Sending marketing emails (only with your consent)

s4.title: 4. Data Transfer to Third Parties
s4.desc: We do not sell your personal data. Data may only be transferred to:
s4.item1: Service partners (e.g., payment systems, hosting providers)
s4.item2: Competent authorities when required by law

s5.title: 5. Use of Cookies
s5.desc: The website uses cookies to ensure its normal operation, improve user experience, and collect statistics. You can manage cookie settings through your browser.

s6.title: 6. Data Retention and Security
s6.desc: We take appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. Data is stored for as long as necessary for the purposes outlined in this policy, unless required otherwise by law.

s7.title: 7. Your Rights
s7.item2: Request correction or deletion of your data
s7.contactText: To exercise these rights, you can contact us at the address listed below.

s8.title: 8. Refund Policy
s8.cancellationDesc: If an event is cancelled on the initiative of EventNest or the organizer, 100% of the ticket/service cost will be refunded.
s8.userCancellationDesc: In case of cancellation initiated by the customer, refunds are made under the following conditions:
s8.item1: Cancellation up to 24 hours prior to the event/service start: 100% refund.
s8.item2: Cancellation less than 24 hours before the event start: non-refundable.
s8.processDesc: Refunds are processed using the same payment method used for the purchase within 3-7 business days after receiving the request.

s9.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
s9.desc: We may update this policy from time to time. In case of changes, the "Last updated" date at the top of the page will be updated.

s10.title: 10. Contact Us
s10.desc: If you have questions regarding this policy or refunds, please contact us:

SEO_TERMS_DESCRIPTION: EventNest terms of service, ticket purchasing, cancellation, and refund policy.

s1.title: 1. Description of Services & Packages
s1.desc: The EventNest event (quiz) ticket/package includes the following services:
s1.item1: Entrance fee for the specified event
s1.item4: Tastings included within the event program
s1.warning: Please note: The package does NOT include extra food, drinks, or transportation expenses.

s2.title: 2. Venue & Entry Procedures
s2.desc: Events are held at Kond House. Entry is managed at the door via a guest list by registered full name. Please arrive before the event start time, as entry may be restricted once the event begins.

s3.title: 3. Cancellation, Refund & Transfer Policy
s3.desc: You may cancel your participation and receive a 100% full refund at least 48 hours prior to the event start. In case of a no-show without prior cancellation, your registration can be transferred to a future event. If an event is cancelled by the organizer, refunds are processed within 3–5 business days. You may also transfer your ticket/spot to another person by notifying us in advance.

s4.title: 4. Dispute Resolution & Contacts
s4.desc: For any inquiries, cancellations, or dispute resolutions, please reach out to us using the contact details below:
